sloka: असि रत्नम् महाबाहो ददामि नृवरात्मज ।गान्धर्वम् अस्त्रम् दयितम् मोहनम् नाम नामतः ॥१-२७-१४॥
transliteration: asi ratnam mahābāho dadāmi nṛvarātmaja ।gāndharvam astram dayitam mohanam nāma nāmataḥ ॥1-27-14॥

translations.english: Rama, I shall grant two much favoured weapons namely gandharvaastras, manava astra, which induce and suppress sleep and sauraastra as well.
